name: home-sentinel
description: Desktop application for monitoring devices connected to a local network.

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run build:main && electron .
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
